title: Zulay 3-Pieces Plastic Funnel Set - Large, Medium, and Small Kitchen Funnels for Filling Bottles - Food Grade Cooking Funnel Set of 3
description:
About this item
3-PIECE KITCHEN FUNNEL SET: Transfer dry or liquid ingredients while keeping the kitchen counter free from spills with these funnels. Available in three different sizes, these large mouth funnels can also be used in a chemistry lab, in restaurants, or anywhere you’d need a precise transfer.
FASTER POURING: Designed with a cone shaped structure and narrow spout, these food funnels can easily fit into smaller containers and narrow bottles. The wide brim mouth makes it quick to pour ingredients like oil, juice, spices, coffee grounds, and even tea leaves.
DURABLE MATERIAL: This oil funnel set is made of high-quality plastic that doesn’t leave any aftertaste and is also suitable for both hot and cold ingredients. These sturdy funnels offer pouring perfection for years to come.
EASY TO STORE AND CLEAN: When you are done funneling your way to delicious meals, stack these plastic funnels or use the loops on the side to hang them for storage. These funnels are top-rack dishwasher friendly, providing an effortless cleanup.
HASSLE-FREE, ZULAY GUARANTEE: We love and take pride in our funnel set and back it up with a lifetime guarantee. If there are any issues, just contact us, and we will make it right. Let’s get pouring with these kitchen funnels!

Textured on the inside so you know it'll be difficult to clean.

Don't waste your time.These are so tiny that youll be at it FOREVER. They should be called Mini funnels. The Large holds about 1/4 cup! Stainless steel is fine but seriously....,I'm not sure why anyone would give this product a decent review. I just received them today and never used because of the terrible quality. Are they lightweight? yes. Are they cheaply made? YES! Sending back the same day I received them, because they are that bad. Super thin plastic, not sturdy, and would not hold up for very long at all.these feel 3d printed which has 2 downsides: 1, the hole size scales with the funnel size, so the small funnel has a hole so small only liquids can pass through, and 2, 3d printing leaves a rough scaly texture on the plastic, which prevents solids like flour or sugar from sliding down the funnel. Next time i will be making sure to get molded plastic funnels.Really disappointed in these. The large funnel is okay, but the medium and small funnels both have a plastic residue inside them, which cannot be cleaned or eliminated. Unfortunately, I threw the packaging away; otherwise, I would have returned them. Warning -- do not purchase.
